changed_dimension: Completion classification, not prompt, model, budget, labels or quality criteria
observed_failure: The ninth preserved pilot call finished with length at 900 tokens, but was treated as a provider outage and stopped the paired run.
hypothesis: Retain a length-limited completion as a failed answer and continue the other planned pairs without retrying.
acceptance: The response remains an error even if its partial output happens to be valid JSON; usage/raw receipt stay intact; outages still stop.
course_source: 2024 Ollama/OpenAI adapter; Module 4 comparing all observed outputs. Failure bookkeeping is an original project adaptation.
tradeoffs: Runs can now spend the remaining predeclared local calls after a truncated response; no extra retries or higher token limit.
Historical raw results are preserved and not relabeled.
next_action: Run both prompt alternatives using this same accounting version.
